method: Twenty consecutive records from captured official NSE RSS, annotated from description text only; no PDF materiality judgement. Ambiguous descriptions remain unclassified. Not a random holdout or full-feed accuracy estimate. Generic recordings without explicit earnings/conference-call identity remain unclassified rather than assuming a quarterly call.
